_about: Recommended Obsidian settings for a Uni OS vault, generated by Uni OS. Merge with the framework's modules/obsidian/scripts/merge_obsidian_config.py (dry run first). The script only adds what is missing; a setting you already chose differently is reported and kept unless you pass --overwrite. The last entry of ignore_filters only matters on Google Drive for desktop (it hides the desktop.ini files Drive drops into every folder).
